title: Candidate pattern: one canonical request pipeline
summary: Model a gateway request as one traceable pipeline with explicit ownership for ingress, authorization, translation, routing, execution, response translation, streaming, and usage recording.
incompatible_when: The system is a small single-stage adapter where a formal pipeline adds no useful ownership boundary.
procedure: Draw the end-to-end request path before changing a cross-cutting behavior.
Give each transformation, policy decision, retry scope, and persistence side effect one canonical owner.
Keep provider-specific behavior behind stable translation and executor boundaries.
Update the architecture diagram and executable checks when a stage or boundary changes.
verification: Trace one request from ingress through response completion in source and confirm each documented stage has one implementation owner.
Exercise streaming and non-streaming paths and confirm usage recording and error translation remain consistent.
rollback: Keep the lesson candidate-only; remove it if reuse shows the staged pipeline adds duplication or obscures the real runtime path.

confidence.rationale: Architecture documentation and the canonical handler/translator source agree, but the pattern has not yet been reused outside OmniRoute.
